From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Aligning TDX timebox & attendees — next steps

Hi Sam — great run through today, thanks for the context. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive (TDX):

Recap (1-line): you want to validate latency/cost for a 15–30 req/s endpoint for your inference pipeline, confirm prefix caching behavior for multi-turn queries, and evaluate routing to a quantized variant for cheaper inference on batch workloads.

Proposal: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML/Infra team to:
- walk your architecture and traffic profile (20–25 min)
- run model-serving walkthrough + KV/prefix cache demo (25–35 min)
- Q&A, runbook & rollout checklist (15–30 min)

Candidate windows (Pacific time):
- Wed, Sep 22 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu, Sep 23 — 13:00–14:30 PT
- Tue, Sep 28 — 09:00–10:30 PT

Can you confirm preferred slot (or share two other times) and the internal attendees from your side? For the session to be productive, it helps to have:
- 1x ML lead (architecture)
- 1x infra/platform or SRE (routing/KV/cache questions)
- optionally, your security architect if you'd like to cover data flow/KMS concerns

I attached a short draft agenda (tdx_agenda_draft.pdf) and a one-page list of pre-read examples. Also linking an editable agenda doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcTDXAgendaDraft

If you pick a slot I’ll loop in Priyom (platform lead) and Marissa (solutions) so we can finalize who from Redwood should join and set up the calendar invite.

Thanks — Vivek
